description: Monophonic vocal gesture contour: PESTO held landings, RMVPE moving pitch, automatic RWBD same-pitch articulation proposals. Fixed 20s targets with independent bounded 30s contexts. Decodes waveform again because frames does not retain model-rate audio. Operator-provisioned model sources and pinned weights are required; no download or fallback. Region window origin is relative to supplied input, not whole-run equivalent. Tail model contexts are zero padded to30s, with decoded and padded PCM digests recorded; target output covers actual audio only.

pitch.description: Fractional MIDI contour; consult voiced mask, unvoiced values are not pitches.

confidence.description: PESTO confidence, not calibrated confidence in final pitch or articulation.

held.description: Held landing rows, 0 or1; RMVPE never replaces their pitch.

attacks.description: Automatic same-pitch articulation proposals passing the frozen qualifier; no new pitch implied.

notes.description: Lossy projected spans with fractional MIDI value. Unlanded runs receive median-pitch spans explicitly flagged in provenance note_reading.uncertain_regions; use pitch for retained motion.

provenance.description: Model source/weight pins, context PCM digests, gesture uncertainty, all attack proposals and detailed note projection.

voiced_fraction.description: Fraction of contour rows marked voiced.
